cases.goal: Preserve explicit zero timeout and retry values. In src/timeout.mjs and src/retries.mjs, replace each || fallback operator with ??. Change nothing else; preserve UTF-8 text and LF newlines.

Make sum([]) return zero. In src/sum.mjs, add 0 as the initial accumulator argument to reduce, using the exact expression values.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0). Change nothing else; preserve UTF-8 text and LF newlines.

files.initial: export const sum = values => values.reduce((a, b) => a + b);
files.expected: export const sum = values => values.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);

cases.goal: Make unique keep only the first occurrence of each value without changing order. In src/unique.mjs, replace the expression [...values] with [...new Set(values)]. Change nothing else; preserve UTF-8 text and LF newlines.

Make range(end) include integers from zero up to but excluding end. In src/range.mjs, change i <= end to i < end. Change nothing else; preserve UTF-8 text and LF newlines.

Sort numbers numerically ascending without mutating the input. In src/sort.mjs, replace .sort() with .sort((a, b) => a - b), retaining .slice(). Change nothing else; preserve UTF-8 text and LF newlines.

files.expected: export const sortNumbers = values => values.slice().sort((a, b) => a - b);

cases.goal: Correct clamp for inputs where low <= high. In src/clamp.mjs, replace Math.max(high, Math.min(low, value)) with Math.min(high, Math.max(low, value)). Change nothing else; preserve UTF-8 text and LF newlines.
